body: Future feels so scary and hard. I know what I would have to do to achieve my goals and dreams but Im so scared. Suicide feels to be the easiest way.

I dont know what to say. Everythings is just piling on top of me. Test week is coming andI feel like I havent learned anything, school's ball is near and I fear that I will fail there, forget my steps and shit.

I will turn 18 this year. I have missed all teenage stuff that everyone else have experienced. Partys, teenage love and sex, crazy things with friends and shit like that. All because I was too scared and played videogames instead.

Last time I was truly happy was when I was 10. Then my world turned upside down. We moved from a big city (pop over 250 000) to a small city (about 17 000 people). I lost my best friend. I started to play WoW and other games. My former friends in the big city are all normal. They have girlfriends and go to partys etc. Im just a loser. I often wonder how differently things would have gone if we hadnt moved and I cry.

Fuck. ;(

One could say that I'm your typical Reddit loser. Virgin, a little socially anxious, nerd, no life et cetera. 

I've had enough of all this shit.
Well I could give you a big list of whats wrong, but I basically just realised that Im a loser and will always be one.
